title: Knowledgebase binding: local-git
description: What adapters/knowledgebase/backends/local-git.md reads from ak.kb.yaml, applied by `ak kb check` after the generic schemas/kb-binding.schema.json has passed. The locator names one registered knowledgebase by id and nothing else: the path of its checkout is the operator's registration, never a committed value. Kept out of the generic schema so that removing this binding removes this file and nothing else.
